name: pi-subagents
description: Pi extension for single-agent delegation and scripted multi-agent workflows
author: Nico Bailon

scripts.test:unit: env -u BASH_ENV node --experimental-strip-types --import ./test/support/isolated-temp-root.mjs --import ../../packages/coding-agent/src/experimental/source-resolver.ts --test --test-skip-pattern="host-owned development packages use the supported SDK baseline" --test-skip-pattern="root entrypoint exposes the runtime error flag" --test-skip-pattern="finds typebox/compile through the running Pi" --test-skip-pattern="import-only SDK agrees across foreground" --test-skip-pattern="classifies only explicit throttling" --test-skip-pattern="renders compact bash output and expanded" --test-skip-pattern="checks startup failure using" test/unit/*.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: env -u BASH_ENV node --experimental-strip-types --import ./test/support/register-loader.mjs --import ../../packages/coding-agent/src/experimental/source-resolver.ts --test --test-skip-pattern="inline summaries" --test-skip-pattern="renders an inconclusive host graph as partial" --test-skip-pattern="keeps final-result failure and output evidence" test/integration/*.test.ts
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
